close_reason: Fixed: changed .get() to .remove() for fetchTextBodyValues, fetchHTMLBodyValues, fetchAllBodyValues in both handle_email_get and handle_email_parse, matching bodyProperties and maxBodyValueBytes.
description: email.rs handle_email_get (L362-373) and handle_email_parse (L1824-1835): bodyProperties and maxBodyValueBytes use args.remove() but fetchTextBodyValues, fetchHTMLBodyValues, fetchAllBodyValues use args.get(), leaving those keys in the map. No documented reason for the split. Fix: use args.remove() consistently for all six body-fetch arguments in both handlers.
title: inconsistent get vs remove for bool body-fetch args
